caption:
Both versions do the exact same thing. Only one of them makes sense six months from now.

Two rules:
1. Give numbers a name (SECONDS_PER_DAY, not 86400)
2. Name functions and variables for what they mean, not what type they are

Code gets read way more than it gets written.

Send this to the teammate who names everything x.
